tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a Cloud site, Data project, Studio browser app, or Mobile Expo starter for this account. Code stays in the browser and has no server-side project. Nothing is deployed or charged.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Cloud sites, Data projects, Studio apps, or Mobile starters owned by this account. Code returns the browser-workspace note.

tools.name: project
tools.description: Read a Cloud page, Studio source, or Mobile Expo draft this account owns. Save replaces Studio source or a Mobile draft and does not publish, start an EAS build, or charge. A Mobile save requires expectedUpdatedAt from the last get or save. Publish Cloud HTML with deploy. Code has no server-side pro

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Publish self-contained HTML to a Cloud site this account owns. Pass projectId instead of html to send a saved Studio page. Public env vars for that site are written into the static page. Private values are not. Cloud is not a Node host. ZIP uploads stay on POST /api/cloud/v1/{siteId} with a Cloud de

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export an owned Studio source ZIP, Mobile Expo project ZIP, or Data project JSON. Does not start an EAS build, publish a site, or run a server. Code has no server-side export.

tools.name: env_vars
tools.description: List, set, update, or delete owner-scoped env vars for Cloud, Data, Mobile, Studio, or the Code workspace. exposure is secret by default. Cloud publish writes public values into the static page and leaves private values out. There is no server runtime.

tools.name: database
tools.description: List or create Data tables, delete a table, and list, query, get, create, batch-create, update, or delete records on a Data project this account owns. list_records accepts the same filter, search, order, and cursor as the project Data API and applies them to the latest 250 rows. list_changes polls r

tools.name: files
tools.description: List, upload, download, or delete private files on a Data project this account owns. Uploads are base64, at most 1 MB, within 100 files and 50 MB per account. This is the existing private bucket, not a public Supabase Storage bucket.

tools.name: eas_dispatch
tools.description: Dispatch an existing workflow on the customer’s Expo project with the Expo token they supply for this call. The token is not stored. The in-app starter is not uploaded. Xyvenra does not pay Expo. Do not call this from guidance.

tools.name: guidance
tools.description: Ask once, calmly, about real next steps across Cloud, Data, Mobile, Studio, Code, and the MCP plugin. Default is to offer the next step. Decline turns a path off. continue creates only the step you name. It does not deploy or charge. If guidancePending is true on status, call this once with action a

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show Code, Cloud, Data, Mobile, and Studio for this account. guidancePending means the one-time next-step ask has not been recorded. Do not repeat that ask after guidance says it was already asked.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: project · Private data: project, deploy, env_vars, database, files, eas_dispatch · Public sink: project, deploy, export, env_vars, files · Destructive: export, env_vars, database, files.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: project · Private data: project, deploy, env_vars, database, files, eas_dispatch · Public sink: project, deploy, export, env_vars, files · Destructive: export, env_vars, database, files

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
